'''Scott Hamman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2000 Minneapolis tournament]] on 8 January 2000 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned beatdown]], according to Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d167">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-10-minneapolis-mn-1-8-00d167/ minneapolis-mn-1-8-00], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 10 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-10-minneapolis-mn-1-8-00d167/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
